title: IN-SHADOW - A Modern Odyssey - Animated Short Film
summary: A 13-minute hand-animated short film that takes a symbolic journey through the unconscious, built around Carl Jung's idea of confronting the Shadow. It mixes 2D animation with spiritual and apocalyptic imagery.
why: Cited as a visual illustration of the Jungian shadow, including in arguments about national or collective shadows and conformity.
